verdict.rationale: Logseq's core block-reference syntax `(())` lets users embed/transclude a specific block from any page into another, and since blocks are stored by reference (not copy), edits stay synced across all transclusions/references automatically — a foundational feature of the outliner. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of sync behavior specifically for transclusion (community evidence focuses on performance/sync-service issues, not block reference correctness), and no docs detail on section/multi-block embed (`{{embed}}`) syntax beyond single block reference.
